Norms tab:: Meaning1 - definition of the first meaning in the Wordsmyth dictionary
Freq1 - mean frequency rating for Meaning1
SE_freq1 - standard error for Freq1
Meaning2 - definition of the second meaning in the Wordsmyth dictionary
Freq2 - mean frequency rating for Meaning2
SE_freq2 - standard error for Freq2
B - dominance score (B), first calculated for each subject and then averaged across subjects (0 - completely balanced, 1 - completely unbalanced homonym)

column2: formula: B = (frequency of the more frequent meaning - frequency of the less frequent meaning)/ frequency of the more frequent meaning (see Armstrong et al., 2012)

Norms tab:: SE_B - standard error for B

Adj_freq1 - mean frequnecy rating for Meaning1 after adding the frequency of additional meanings that are considered variants of Meaning1 (senses) in the Wordsmyth dictionary (consistent with Armstrong et al., 2012)
AmE_freq1 - mean frequency rating for Meaning1 in American-English eDom norms (taken from Armstrong et al., 2012)
#subjects1 - number of subjects who gave Meaning 1 a frequency rating of 0
#subjects2 - number of subjects who gave Meaning 2 a frequency rating of 0
Additional Meanings tab:
Subject_def - subjects' definition of the additional meaning
#subjects - number of subjects who provided the additional meaning
Mean_freq - mean frequency rating for the additional meaning
Stimulus Properties tab:
Relatedness - mean relatedness between the two word meanings (1 - highly unrelated, 4 - neither unrelated nor related, 7 - highly related), provided by 30 native BrE speakers
Letters - number of letters
Phonemes - number of phonemes
Syllables - number of syllables
Raw_freq - word-form frequency (occurences per million) in the British National Corpus (BNC, 2007)
Log_freq - log-transformed Raw_freq
N - number of orthographic neighbours in the BNC (2007)
Log_bigram - log-transformed frequency of the bigram in the BNC (2007)
Senses1 - number of word senses in the Wordsmyth Online Dictionary (Parks et al., 1998)
Senses2 - number of word senses in the WordNet Dictionary 2.1 (Fellbaum, 1998)
SemD - semantic diversity values (Hoffman et al., 2013)
Imageability - ratings from Bristol (Stadthagen-Gonzalez & Davis, 2006) and MRC norms (Coltheart, 1981)
Concreteness - ratings from MRC norms (Coltheart, 1981)
AoA - age of acquisition ratings (Kuperman et al., 2012)
Familiarity - subjective familiarity ratings from MRC norms (Coltheart, 1981)
#nouns - number of noun interpretions in the Wordsmyth dictionary
#verbs - number of verb interpretions in the Wordsmyth dictionary
#adjectives - number of noun interpretions in the Wordsmyth dictionary
Participants tab:
Location - participant's current place of residence
